Bloodborne Pathogens Exposure Incident Procedure

IMMEDIATE ACTIONS:

1. Wash needlestick/cut with soap and water

2. Flush splashes to nose/mouth/skin with water

3. Irrigate eyes with clean water/saline

4. Report immediately to supervisor

5. Seek immediate medical evaluation

Biohazard Spill Response Procedures

SMALL SPILL (<100 ML, CONTAINED):

1. Alert others in area

2. Don appropriate PPE (gloves, gown, eye protection, mask)

3. Cover spill with absorbent material

4. Apply appropriate disinfectant (______% bleach or EPA-registered disinfectant)

5. Allow contact time (______ minutes)

6. Wipe up and dispose in biohazard waste

7. Decontaminate surface again

LARGE SPILL (>100 ML OR AEROSOL GENERATED):

1. Clear area immediately

2. Allow aerosols to settle (30+ minutes)

3. Post warning signs

4. Don full PPE (including respiratory protection)

5. Cover spill with absorbent material

6. Pour disinfectant around edges, then center

7. Allow contact time (______ minutes)

8. Clean up and dispose properly

9. Decontaminate area and equipment

CENTRIFUGE SPILL (WITH AEROSOLIZATION):

1. Shut off centrifuge, do not open for 30 minutes

2. Don full PPE including respiratory protection

3. Carefully open rotor/sealed buckets inside BSC

4. Decontaminate according to procedure
